import requests

def get_uniprot_info(gene_name, organism="9606"):
    url = f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?query=gene_exact:{gene_name}+AND+organism_id:{organism}&fields=accession,id,gene_names,protein_name,mass,sequence"
    resp = requests.get(url).json()
    return resp

tnfrsf10b = get_uniprot_info("TNFRSF10B")
klf11 = get_uniprot_info("KLF11")

print("TNFRSF10B:")
for r in tnfrsf10b.get('results', []):
    gene = [g.get('geneName', {}).get('value') for g in r.get('genes', [])]
    protein = r.get('proteinDescription', {}).get('recommendedName', {}).get('fullName', {}).get('value')
    mass = r.get('sequence', {}).get('molWeight')
    length = r.get('sequence', {}).get('length')
    print(r['primaryAccession'], gene, protein, mass, length)

print("\nKLF11:")
for r in klf11.get('results', []):
    gene = [g.get('geneName', {}).get('value') for g in r.get('genes', [])]
    protein = r.get('proteinDescription', {}).get('recommendedName', {}).get('fullName', {}).get('value')
    mass = r.get('sequence', {}).get('molWeight')
    length = r.get('sequence', {}).get('length')
    print(r['primaryAccession'], gene, protein, mass, length)

import requests

def get_entry_details(accession):
    url = f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{accession}.json"
    data = requests.get(url).json()
    
    # Check isoforms
    comments = data.get('comments', [])
    for c in comments:
        if c.get('commentType') == 'ALTERNATIVE PRODUCTS':
            print(f"Alternative products for {accession}:")
            for iso in c.get('isoforms', []):
                print(iso.get('name'), iso.get('isoformIds'), iso.get('sequenceIds'))
                
get_entry_details("O14763")
get_entry_details("O14901")

def get_isoform_masses(accession):
    url = f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?query=accession:{accession}&includeIsoform=true&fields=accession,id,mass,length"
    res = requests.get(url).json()
    for r in res.get('results', []):
        print(r['primaryAccession'], r.get('sequence', {}).get('molWeight'), r.get('sequence', {}).get('length'))

print("TNFRSF10B isoforms:")
get_isoform_masses("O14763")

print("\nKLF11 isoforms:")
get_isoform_masses("O14901")
